svg.title: One profile projected and painted
svg.desc: Left: the type-23 profile silhouette at its true proportions. Middle: the spans the lathe draws row by row, with the two-colour terminator. Right: the same structure as the buffer holds it, with the horizon at row 96.
svg.text: From a profile to a painted tower
Type 23 at a distance of $0280 (2.5 cells), level with the ship. Q = floor($8000 ÷ 640) = 51.
The lathe: one span a screen row
Height in rows = 128 × length ÷ distance. Half-width in columns = 128 × radius ÷ distance.
The same factor on both axes, so the silhouette is never stretched.
Every span is two fills: $AA (pair 10) takes the matrix byte's low nibble on the left; $55 (pair 01) its high nibble on the right.
Rows where (profile flags + $12) & $20 is set are filled with $FF — pair 11, colour RAM: colour 3. Shown at $12 = $1E.
